sources.title: 2026年11月10日中国外汇交易中心受权公布人民币汇率中间价公告
sources.publisher: People's Bank of China (中国人民银行)
sources.quote: 2026年11月10日银行间外汇市场人民币汇率中间价为1美元对人民币6.7167元
sources.supports: The official reference mid-rate is CNY 6.7167 per USD on 2026-11-10. This is a published reference rate, not a rate any bank must give you.

sources.title: 中国银行电子银行个人服务转账汇款费率表
sources.quote: 跨境汇款（电汇）：每笔汇款金额的1‰，最低收取50元/笔，最高收取260元/笔；另收电讯费，港澳台地区人民币80元/笔，非港澳台地区人民币150元/笔。备注：1、另有协议约定、价格优惠、地方性收费差异的，按照协议或当地公示的内容收取相关费用。
sources.supports: BOC cross-border telegraphic transfer: 0.1% of the remitted amount, minimum CNY 50, maximum CNY 260 per transaction, plus a CNY 150 cable fee for non-HK/Macau/Taiwan destinations. Local fee variation is expressly possible.

sources.supports: HSBC China Premier outward telegraphic transfer: 0.1% of amount, min CNY 100, max CNY 500, plus CNY 120 cable; HSBC Global Transfers between own HSBC accounts are free for Premier; HSBC China stopped issuing foreign-currency drafts on 2019-12-01.

sources.title: （已修改）国家外汇管理局关于印发《个人外汇管理办法实施细则》的通知
sources.publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (国家外汇管理局)
sources.published: 2007-01-05 (still in force, with amendments noted on the page)
sources.quote: 第二条 对个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理。年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元。…第十条 境内个人经常项目项下非经营性结汇超过年度总额的，凭本人有效身份证件及以下证明材料在银行办理…第十三条 境外个人经常项目合法人民币收入购汇及未用完的人民币兑回…（含税务凭证）…第十四条 境内个人外汇汇出境外用于经常项目支出…当日累计等值5万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理；超过上述金额的，凭经常项目项下有交易额的真实性凭证办理。…第三十条 个人提取外币现钞当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，可以在银行直接办理；超过上述金额的…向银行所在地外汇局事前报备。注：…以下内容已被废止：《个人外汇管理办法实施细则》（汇发〔2007〕1号印发）第三十九条。
sources.supports: The USD 50,000 annual total applies to settlement and purchase separately per person per year; amounts above it are handled against genuine-transaction documents; outward remittance up to USD 50,000/day from an FX savings account is ID-only; cash withdrawal above USD 10,000 needs prior SAFE filing; the old Article 39 fine schedule is repealed.

sources.short: Individual property transfer abroad (2004 interim measures)
sources.title: 中国人民银行发布实施《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》
sources.publisher: People's Bank of China, published on SAFE site
sources.quote: 移民转移是指从中国内地移居外国…将其在取得移民身份之前在境内拥有的合法财产变现，通过外汇指定银行购汇和汇出境外的行为。继承转移是指外国公民…将依法继承的境内遗产变现…第六条 移民转移必须一次性申请拟转移出境的全部财产金额，分步汇出…第八条…（六）申请转移财产所在地或收入来源地主管税务机关开具的税收证明或完税凭证。第十三条…按照《中华人民共和国外汇管理条例》第四十条的规定给予处罚。
sources.supports: There is a dedicated approval route for (a) emigrants moving pre-emigration assets and (b) foreign citizens remitting inherited Chinese estates. It requires a tax clearance/tax payment certificate and SAFE approval. The staged-release wording in Art. 6 has since been superseded — see S07.

sources.title: （已修改）国家外汇管理局关于进一步改进和调整资本项目外汇管理政策的通知
sources.quote: 六、简化个人财产转移售付汇管理（一）…取消财产转移总金额超过等值人民币50万元报国家外汇管理局备案的要求。（二）取消移民财产转移分次汇出的要求。申请人向原户籍所在地外汇局办理移民财产转移核准手续后，银行可在核准件审批额度内一次或分次汇出相关资金。（三）取消继承人从不同被继承人处继承的财产应分别申请、分别汇出的要求。…（四）取消对有关财产权利文件…进行公证的要求
sources.supports: The 2004 half/half/remainder staged-release rule and the CNY 500,000 central-SAFE filing requirement were cancelled in 2014; remittance can be once or in instalments within the approved amount. Local implementation still has to be confirmed with the competent SAFE branch.

sources.short: PRC Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations (State Council Order 532)
sources.title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例（国务院令第532号）
sources.publisher: State Council of the PRC (中国政府网)
sources.quote: 第三十九条 有违反规定将境内外汇转移境外，或者以欺骗手段将境内资本转移境外等逃汇行为的…处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。第四十二条 违反规定携带外汇出入境的…可以处违法金额20%以下的罚款。第四十五条 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇、倒买倒卖外汇或者非法介绍买卖外汇数额较大的…没收违法所得，处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。第四十八条…对个人可以处5万元以下的罚款。
sources.supports: The statutory penalty ladder for illegal cross-border FX movement: up to 30% of the amount normally, 30% to 100% where serious, plus confiscation and criminal liability. Cash violations are capped at 20%. Administrative fines for individuals under Art. 48 are capped at CNY 50,000.

sources.title: 国家外汇管理局 海关总署关于印发《携带外币现钞出入境管理暂行办法》的通知
sources.publisher: SAFE and General Administration of Customs
sources.quote: 出境人员携带不超过等值5000美元（含5000美元）的外币现钞出境的，无须申领《携带证》，海关予以放行；…在等值5000美元以上至10000美元（含10000美元）的，应向外汇指定银行申领《携带证》…出境人员原则上不得携带超过等值10000美元的外币现钞出境
sources.supports: Physical cash is capped: under USD 5,000 no permit; USD 5,000-10,000 requires a bank-issued carrying certificate; above USD 10,000 is in principle not allowed and needs an exceptional SAFE permit.

sources.title: Individual Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China
sources.publisher: State Taxation Administration (国家税务总局)
sources.quote: Article 1 …an individual who is not domiciled in China but has resided in China for an aggregate of 183 days or more within a tax year, shall be regarded as a resident individual. Income received by a resident individual from within China or overseas shall be subject to individual income tax… Article 3 …(3) For income from interest, dividends or bonuses, income from leasing of assets, income from transfer of assets, and incidental income, a flat tax rate of 20 percent shall apply.
sources.supports: China taxes residents on worldwide income; asset-transfer income and interest/dividends are taxed at a flat 20%; comprehensive income (salary etc.) is progressive 3%-45%. The law taxes income, not the act of exchanging currency.

sources.title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
sources.quote: A U.S. person… must file an FBAR to report: a financial interest in or signature or other authority over at least one financial account located outside the United States if the aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year reported. …due April 15 following the calendar year reported. You're allowed an automatic extension to October 15
sources.supports: A US citizen with a Chinese bank account over USD 10,000 at any point in the year has an FBAR filing obligation, independent of whether any tax is due. Due 15 April, automatic extension to 15 October.

sources.title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
sources.quote: Specified individuals living in the US: Unmarried individual… more than $50,000 on the last day of the tax year, or more than $75,000 at any time during the year. Married individual filing jointly: more than $100,000 on the last day… or more than $150,000 at any time… Penalties: Up to $10,000 for failure to disclose and an additional $10,000 for each 30 days of non-filing after IRS notice… potential maximum penalty of $60,000
sources.supports: Form 8938 thresholds for a US-resident filer and the statutory penalty structure for non-disclosure.

sources.title: 26 U.S.C. Sec. 988 - Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions
sources.quote: (e) Application to individuals — (1) In general: The preceding provisions of this section shall not apply to any section 988 transaction entered into by an individual which is a personal transaction. (2) Exclusion for certain personal transactions: If— (A) nonfunctional currency is disposed of by an individual in any transaction, and (B) such transaction is a personal transaction, no gain shall be recognized… The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200.
sources.supports: Converting personal funds is a personal transaction: FX gain is generally not recognised, but the exclusion switches off once the gain exceeds USD 200. The provision does not create a deduction for personal FX losses.

sources.short: IRS - gifts from a foreign person (Form 3520)
sources.title: Gifts from foreign person
sources.quote: For gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate, you are required to report the receipt of such gifts or bequests only if the aggregate amount received… exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year. …For purported gifts from foreign corporations or foreign partnerships… exceeds $20,116 for 2025, and $20,573 for 2026
sources.supports: A US person receiving more than USD 100,000 in aggregate from a nonresident individual must file Form 3520 Part IV. Reporting is not itself a tax on the gift.

sources.title: Foreign Tax Credit
sources.quote: If you paid or accrued foreign taxes to a foreign country… and are subject to U.S. tax on the same income, you may be able to take either a credit or an itemized deduction for those taxes. …File Form 1116… Taken as a credit, foreign income taxes reduce your U.S. tax liability.
sources.supports: Chinese income tax paid on the same income can generally be credited against US tax on that income via Form 1116, subject to limitation. It does not refund the Chinese tax.

sources.title: U.S. citizens and resident aliens abroad
sources.quote: You are subject to tax on worldwide income from all sources and must report all taxable income and pay taxes according to the Internal Revenue Code. …Receipt of more than $100,000 in gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien individual or foreign estate
sources.supports: US citizenship alone creates a worldwide-income filing obligation regardless of where the money sits or is converted.

sources.title: Guide to CNY transfers
sources.quote: You can send money from CNY if: You're not mainland Chinese… You're working or have worked in China before… You have a valid tax record issued by the China tax authority showing taxes paid within the last 3 years… Due to regulations, you can only send CNY from China to another account you own. …If you're sending CNY from your China bank app, the maximum you can send in one transfer is 300,000 CNY. …your overall limit is the amount of salary you've earned in China after deducting the amount of tax paid in China.
sources.supports: Wise's China-out rail is eligibility-limited (non-mainland-Chinese national with China work history and tax records), capped at CNY 300,000 per transfer, payable only to your own account, and capped overall at net salary. Wise's own page says to check live pricing for the fee.

sources.title: Chase checking account fees (incoming wire transfers)
sources.quote: Domestic and international incoming wires have a $15 fee per transfer. Financial institutions may deduct processing fees and/or charges from the amount of the wire transfer
sources.supports: A representative US receiving-bank charge of USD 15 per incoming international wire. This is Chase-specific; the user's actual bank is unknown.

sources.title: FinCEN Form 105 - Currency and Other Monetary Instruments Report
sources.publisher: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, US Treasury
sources.quote: BSA regulations stipulate that a CMIR must be used to report the physical transportation of "currency or other monetary instruments" in an aggregate amount exceeding $10,000 at one time… from the United States to any place outside the United States, or into the United States from any place outside the United States.
sources.supports: Physically bringing more than USD 10,000 into the US requires a FinCEN 105 declaration; failure to declare is a separate offence from any Chinese rule.
